population: All members of the four 2025 quarterly archives plus the 2025 registrations archive listed by the official House download index, acquired 7 October 2026. These are report-year archive selections, not a received-during-2025 census.
interpretation: Originals, amendments, termination reports and amended terminations are separate document records. The same relationship legitimately occurs in multiple quarters and in registration files. All thirteen initial major totals were separately verified by API posting chronology and original HTML. House snapshot is not independently proven identical to API population.
